formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (H : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (qH : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (m : ℕ) (u T W z : ℕ → ℕ) (NR : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (P : ℕ → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool) (G0 : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (rho : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ y0 : Fin n → Bool, qH y0 = true ↔ ∃ a0 b0 : Fin n, H.Adj a0 b0 ∧ y0 a0 = true ∧ y0 b0 = true) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → (∀ y1 : Fin n → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn y1) = qH y1) → (∀ k0 r0 : ℕ, NR k0 r0 ↔ r0 < C.gates.length ∧ n + u k0 ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C r0).inputs ∧ (r0 = T k0 ∨ (PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C (W k0) r0 ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C r0).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or))) → (∀ (k1 : ℕ) (y2 : Fin n → Bool), P k1 y2 = decide (∃ w1 : Fin n, y2 w1 = true ∧ PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C (n + u k1) (fun j1 : Fin n => decide (j1 = w1 ∨ (j1 : ℕ) = z k1)) = true)) → (∀ k2 < m, u k2 < C.gates.length ∧ T k2 < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (T k2)).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ z k2 < n ∧ ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (T k2)).inputs = [W k2, z k2] ∨ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (T k2)).inputs = [z k2, W k2]) ∧ (∀ y3 : Fin n → Bool, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C (n + T k2) y3 = true → qH y3 = true) ∧ ∀ g2 < C.gates.length, PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone n C (T k2) g2 → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C g2).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) → (∀ k3 < m, ∀ g3 < C.gates.length, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C (W k3) g3 → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C g3).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone n C (u k3) g3 → C.output ≠ n + g3 ∧ ∀ r3 < C.gates.length, n + g3 ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C r3).inputs → r3 = T k3 ∨ (PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C (W k3) r3 ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C r3).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or)) → (∀ k4 < m, ∀ k5 < m, ∀ r4 : ℕ, NR k5 r4 → r4 ≠ u k4 ∧ ¬ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone n C r4 (u k4)) → (∀ i6 < G0.length, ∀ w6 ∈ (G0.getD i6 ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, []⟩).inputs, w6 < n + i6) → D = ⟨G0 ++ C.gates.mapIdx (fun r7 g7 => ({ op := g7.op, inputs := g7.inputs.map (fun i7 => rho r7 i7) } : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate)), if C.output < n then C.output else C.output + G0.length⟩ → (∀ r8 < C.gates.length, ∀ i8 ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C r8).inputs, (∀ k8 < m, ¬ (NR k8 r8 ∧ i8 = n + u k8)) → rho r8 i8 = if i8 < n then i8 else i8 + G0.length) → (∀ r9 : ℕ, ∀ k9 < m, NR k9 r9 → (rho r9 (n + u k9) < n + G0.length ∧ ∀ y9 : Fin n → Bool, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n (⟨G0, 0⟩ : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (rho r9 (n + u k9)) y9 = P k9 y9) ∨ (∃ g9 < r9, rho r9 (n + u k9) = n + G0.length + g9 ∧ (∀ y10 : Fin n → Bool, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C (n + g9) y10 = P k9 y10) ∧ ∀ k10 < m, ∀ r10 : ℕ, NR k10 r10 → r10 ≠ g9 ∧ ¬ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone n C r10 g9) ∨ ((∀ y11 : Fin n → Bool, P k9 y11 = false) ∧ n + G0.length + r9 ≤ rho r9 (n + u k9))) → ∀ y12 : Fin n → Bool, D.eval (List.ofFn y12) = qH y12
plain_statement: f(x): x has both ends of some edge of graph H true. C: AND/OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires, computes f. Pairs (u, T): T = W AND z, z an input, T <= f, only ORs depend on T; O: ORs below W via ORs; narrowed: reads of u by T or O; ORs of O depending on u are read only in O, T, not the output; P: the w with u true at {w, z}. No u depends on a narrowed reader. Prepend gates, shift reads, send each narrowed read to a wire = OR(P): prepended, an input, an earlier gate no narrowed reader feeds, or (P empty) one past the reader. Result computes f.
title: Narrow at several star pairs, exact fan-in-two AND/OR: sending each pair's narrowed reads to OR of its cofactor star keeps the edge function
